focus: Eliminate a remaining critical visible_lod_pop risk in crescent-lock hardware by preserving the same manufactured curved lever envelope through LOD2 and LOD3 rather than allowing the existing broad-box/sliver far proxies to replace the curve.

commits.message: qa: define sash latch far LOD continuity contract
unity: preserve sash latch curve through far LODs
qa: bind sash latch far LOD continuity to reflection evidence
qa: require far LOD continuity in reflection binding
qa: add sash latch far LOD lookdev plate

implementation.constructionReasoning: LOD2 and LOD3 now remain decimated representations of the same manufactured crescent latch: plate, swept metal lever and keeper stay physically separate before one-renderer combination. Simplification reduces curve sampling instead of changing the product into a rectangular slab. Geometry carries the lever sweep, section, keeper clearance and product silhouette; aged-metal microstructure, roughness, Fresnel response and contact polish remain material/lighting behavior.
implementation.weatheringReasoning: No new weathering layer was invented for distance LODs. Far proxies inherit the canonical aged sash metal and therefore cannot introduce independent rust, wetness, dirt, value shifts or painted highlight bands.
implementation.formalEvidenceBehavior: The first reflection-lighting baseline may create/repair deterministic LOD2/LOD3 phase assets, then their dependency hashes are armed. Every later reflection fingerprint revalidates the same assets read-only and fails closed on drift. This awards zero Visual Fidelity points.

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.temporalLodAliasingStability: HIGH risk reduction if native-4K motion confirms that 16->8->5 ring transitions are imperceptible; specifically targets the visible_lod_pop critical-fail path.
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.geometryConstructionFidelity: MEDIUM preservation benefit because distant hardware remains recognizably the same manufactured crescent assembly rather than becoming a generic slab.
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.materialPbrPhysicalPlausibility: LOW-to-MEDIUM indirect benefit because the curved metal surface preserves a physically coherent specular trajectory better than a rectangular substitute; actual BRDF appearance remains unverified.
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.lightingShadowsReflections: LOW-to-MEDIUM indirect benefit because reflection-probe evidence and still/temporal evidence now consume the same far-LOD asset payloads after the formal epoch is armed.

unresolvedPixelRisks: The 8-ring LOD2 curve may still facet or move its specular centroid visibly under grazing light.
The 5-ring LOD3 curve may still read as angular or shimmer at sub-pixel coverage even though it preserves the crescent envelope.
Animated cross-fade may expose density or highlight differences between 16, 8 and 5 rings.
Receiver/keeper clearance and sash/gasket separation remain unverified in actual pixels at forced LODs.
Eight deterministic UV phases may still reveal repetition across thirty windows in real camera framing.
Runtime cost, mesh serialization behavior and Unity 6000.3.0f1 compilation are not verified without a Runner.
nextBlocker: A real Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner or rendered screenshots. When available, stop speculative expansion and run compile/runtime first, then capture native 3840x2160 oblique temporal evidence crossing 0.003 and 0.0012, grazing-light evidence, and 100-percent sash-latch crops. Reject any visible silhouette snap, rectangular read, specular jump, shimmer, interpenetration or LOD pop before entering Visual Fidelity scores.
